notes.title: Flying Soul Update 1.2
notes.content:

More news is coming!

notes.title: Flying Soul Update Pack 1
notes.content:
Since the launch of the game on Steam Several small updates added to the first update pack of the game.
Here is the list of improvements made:
[list]
    [*]Restart Level pressing button X
    [*]Tutorial Level restructured
    [*]White Squares angle are now 45º
    [*]Bug that happened when the player finished the squares and the time was up, but the game over did not happen.
    [*]The Squares color was changed smooth
    [*]Time rebalanced
    [*]Block size changed to improve the gameplay
    [*]Box Life green added
[/list]

Thanks for playing!
More news are coming!

notes.title: Flying Soul just released!
notes.content:
With great pride we bring to Steam a our game [b]Flying Soul[/b]!
This game brings a new vision of how to play a flying game without battles or shooting. It brings a new form of puzzle never seen before.

We hope you enjoy the game and please leave feedback at the Community Hub. All the suggestions presented will be analyzed.

If you find bugs or want to suggest improvements let us know through the Community Hub!

[b][i]Thank you![/i][/b]
